VDO syllabus and written test (Advt 04/2022)

  • 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 2 hours, on an OMR sheet.
  • Negative marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.
SectionApprox. weightTopics
GK and current affairs25Politics, environment, science and technology, economy, Punjab history from the 14th century, Indian freedom struggle, sports, cinema and literature
Mental ability25Coding-decoding, analogy, series, directions, blood relations, Venn diagrams, cubes and dice, mirror images, puzzles, non-verbal series
English12Grammar, synonyms and antonyms, one-word substitution, error correction, narration, voice, idioms
Punjabi13Spelling, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms, parts of speech, gender and number, idioms, translation from English
Mathematical skills25Percentage, number system, LCM and HCF, ratio, average, ages, profit and loss, interest, time and work, time and distance, mensuration, data interpretation

This VDO syllabus is the best guide to what a new Panchayat Secretary paper would look like, since the two posts sit in the same department and need the same skills.
